author: Mike Crawley
description: U.S. President Donald Trump signed a proclamation Thursday declaring the Oval Office and Cabinet room of the White House to be national monuments.
title: Trump declares his redesigned Oval Office a national monument

author: Simon Little
description: One of two people charged in relation to the death of an 11-year-old Burnaby boy appeared in a Vancouver courtroom for the first time on Thursday.
title: Man accused of killing 11-year-old Burnaby boy makes 1st court appearance

description: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk is safely back inside the International Space Station after successfully completing his second spacewalk in two weeks.
title: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk completes second spacewalk, more than six hours long

author: Jessica Wong
description: Rush may be currently delighting fans while on tour, but the Canadian Music Hall of Famers are already prepping for the next high-profile gig soon after its wraps: a week-long residency at immersive Las Vegas venue Sphere.
title: Rush announces week-long concert series in Las Vegas

description: AI stocks worldwide felt pressure as worries rise about possible moratoriums on data centres following Democratic victories in the U.S. midterm elections.
title: AI stock sell-off sends the S&P 500 down 4.4% in worst day since April 2025

author: Stephanie Hogan
description: California governor Gavin Newsom is commuting the death sentences of more than 500 inmates to life in prison with no parole, saying he believes state-sanctioned killing is incompatible with the values of California, undermines the foundations of the legal system and "diminishes each of us."
title: California Gov. Gavin Newsom says he'll commute all death row sentences to life in prison

description: No, Canada did not light up Niagara Falls blue to celebrate Democrats’ wins in the U.S. midterm elections. CBC’s Fact Check team debunks the claim.
title: Fact check: Did Canada light up Niagara Falls blue for Democrats?

author: Benjamin Lopez Steven
description: The Carney government's new budget proposes roughly $5 billion over the next five years toward several initiatives to promote Canadian culture, including building new recreational facilities and ice rinks, supporting national museums and permanently making their admissions free for people 25 and younger.
title: Canada's new budget proposes $5B for culture. Here's where it would go

author: Abby Hughes
description: The 2026 budget increases payments for the Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit and expands a tax credit for low-wage workers. But the affordability measures are mostly for the short term, and took a back seat to measures aimed at boosting investment.
title: From gas to groceries, how much is in the federal budget for your wallet?

author: Jeff Lagerquist
description: The federal government has released draft regulations to stop banks from charging fees when a client moves an investment account to a different financial institution.
title: Ottawa readies ban on fees for moving investment accounts

author: Helen Surgenor
description: Months after three female cast members came forward with allegations of sexual assault on the set of Married at First Sight UK, the results of an external review have prompted Channel 4 to decide not to bring the show back.
title: Married at First Sight UK cancelled after review, sexual assault allegations

description: A Mexican judge has been arrested on allegations that he accepted a $2-million US bribe in exchange for granting bail to a man accused of acting as second-in-command to Ryan Wedding, the former Canadian Olympic snowboarder turned alleged drug kingpin, American officials said on Thursday.
title: Mexican judge arrested over alleged $2M bribe to release Ryan Wedding's second-in-command

author: Jessica Wong
description: Given how deeply Google products are embedded in many Canadian classrooms, alarm bells were set off when the company told schools that switching off artificial intelligence tools totally will also cut access to its ubiquitous search engine.
title: Google offers schools AI-boosted search or none at all

author: Natalie Stechyson
description: Maple Leaf raised prices earlier this year to help offset higher costs — the second such price increase in a year — but it hasn't been enough to mitigate rising expenses.
title: Maple Leaf Foods plans to raise prices again early next year, CEO says in earnings call

description: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned hours after the country's central bank seized Ueno Bank, which claimed more than 60 per cent of the country's adults as customers.
title: Bank collapse sinks Paraguay's President Santiago Peña, who resigns as customers fear their savings are gone

description: LIV Golf is winding down operations instead of launching a new version because of a lack of financial support.
title: LIV Golf shutting down operations, lawyer says in bankruptcy hearing

description: The Court of Arbitration for Sport defended its decision to reinstate Russia to international hockey competition Thursday, saying the ruling was based strictly on the legal arguments and evidence presented.
title: Court of Arbitration for Sport defends Russian hockey reinstatement, says IIHF failed to justify ban

description: A network outage affecting Telus customers is disrupting phone and wireless services in multiple areas across Ontario and Quebec, with some unable to call 911 on mobile, the company says.
title: Telus outage disrupting phone, wireless services across areas in Ontario and Quebec

author: Jack Farrell
description: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith says sweeping Democrat wins in the U.S. midterm elections prove her province was on the right path in the cross-border trade war.
title: U.S. midterms are a 'vindication' of Alberta's approach to tariffs, says Premier Smith

description: CBC is announcing the launch of CBC Money, a new slate of original content coming next year that will focus on the daily cost-of-living news that matters to Canadians.
title: CBC Money to launch next year with slate of original content dedicated to personal finance

description: Some protesters clashed with police in Paris and Lyon on Thursday during largely peaceful nationwide demonstrations and a one-day strike by some public sector workers in a renewed challenge to President Emmanuel Macron.
title: Largely peaceful marches across France as workers stage strike, some police clashes reported

description: British comedian and actor Russell Brand was convicted Thursday of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault linked to allegations dating back more than 20 years. He was acquitted of two rape counts and one count of attempted indecent assault.
title: Russell Brand convicted of rape and sexual assault

description: Cristiano Ronaldo announced on Thursday he won't play for Portugal anymore, ending a career that spanned six World Cups and included a European title and the men's all-time international scoring record.
title: Portugal great Cristiano Ronaldo announces his retirement from international soccer

author: Julia Wong
description: Pte. Liam Ramage, 27, of Red Deer, Alta., was one of dozens of service members hurt in an out-of-control grass fire at CFB Wainwright on Oct. 17.
title: Family of injured Wainwright soldier holds bedside vigil in burn unit

description: Bomb threats forced airliners to make unplanned landings across Europe on ‌Thursday morning, the latest in a series of threats targeting flights in Europe.
title: Bomb threats force planes into emergency landings at several European airports

author: Josh Hoffman
description: Residents say they're fed up with blowing sand from the site of a subdivision development in the middle of a quiet neighbourhood in Coldbrook, N.S.
title: ‘Everybody’s pissed’: Sand blowing into homes next to rural N.S. subdivision development

author: Lauren Pelley
description: A third of Canadian youth have faced dating violence — from physical and sexual abuse to online harassment — warns new guidance for health-care providers to help them screen for abusive relationships among kids and teens.
title: 1 in 3 young people in Canada have faced dating violence, pediatricians warn

author: Jason Markusoff, Joel Dryden, Nael Shiab
description: Danielle Smith's MLAs approved a panel's controversial boundary plan over NDP protests.
title: Alberta's new riding map skews Lethbridge, Banff, Calgary seats toward UCP, voter data suggests

description: CBC News speaks to documentarian Habiba Nosheen about her new documentary, The Gymnasts of Fisherman Colony.
title: Habiba Nosheen on her new documentary — and working with Malala

author: Gurpreet Virdi-Bains
description: Gurpreet Virdi-Bains enrolled her daughters in an after-school math enrichment program to help them get ahead. As she reflects on her own childhood, she considers what it means to be a good parent.
title: I thought extra academics made me a good mom. Now I wonder what my daughters lost

author: Jonathan Ore
description: The latest in the long-running series of crime simulators by Rockstar Games is predicted to be the biggest release in video game history.
title: Is Grand Theft Auto VI the most anticipated video game of all time? Here are some reasons why

author: Paul Forsyth
description: Niagara police say they are investigating an act of vandalism Saturday in St. Catharines, Ont., as a "hate-motivated crime." B'nai Brith Canada says the incident is part of a disturbing trend of escalating antisemitism in Canada
title: Niagara police investigate 'hate-motivated' vandalism in St. Catharines, Ont.

author: Anand Ram
description: Never before has this Hindu myth looked as visually stunning, nor involved so much top-tier talent from across India's and other film industries. But the final effect is mixed.
title: Ramayana: Part 1 has the muscle, but lacks a certain epic soul

author: Elizabeth Thompson
description: CBC News has learned that Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada quietly put permanent resident applications on hold for an unknown number of people who could now qualify for citizenship by descent.
title: Some permanent resident applicants left in limbo by changes to Canadian citizenship law

author: Kevin Maimann
description: Academic libraries are fighting off swarms of data-scraping bots — that are slowing or crashing sites meant for students, researchers and the public — as AI companies continue hunting for content to feed their large language models.
title: University libraries are being swarmed by AI bots, putting public access at risk

author: Nicole Mortillaro
description: While the most significant impact on the global temperature typically comes in the months after an El Niño peak — which hasn't happened yet — some climate models are suggesting 2026 could edge out 2024 as the warmest year on record. Could El Niño be influencing this year's global temperature?
title: Will this year’s super El Niño push 2026 to be the warmest year on record?
